issue.title: Deterministic PR CI + weekday Expo compatibility sync
issue.body:
## Problem

Two separate problems are being treated as one:

1. **Feature PRs rot overnight** — the same commit was green yesterday and is red today without rebasing onto a changed `main`. Something in CI is floating (or Expo’s published compatibility matrix moved).
2. **Expo SDK patch drift is discovered by every open PR independently** — we already paid for this twice with dedicated tickets ([#314](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/314), [#343](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/343)): `npx expo install --fix` on a ticketed branch so Quality Gates go green, then rebase Dependabot/feature PRs.

Dependabot is doing its job (weekly grouped npm + Actions). It does **not** understand Expo’s SDK pin matrix, so Expo-managed packages and “latest on npm” diverge. Agents then run a one-at-a-time merge queue by hand ([docs/guides/dependabot-process.md](docs/guides/dependabot-process.md)).

## Current vs expected

| | Today | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Install in CI | `npm ci` (lockfile-frozen) — good | Keep |
| Node | `node-version: 24` (latest 24.x) | Pin to `package.json` `engines` (`>=24.14.0` → exact CI version, e.g. `24.14.0`) |
| `npm run doctor` | `npx expo-doctor@latest` | Never `@latest` in PR CI; pin or use the local/lockfile CLI |
| Quality Gates | `npx expo-doctor` + `npx expo install --check` on **every** PR | PR: deterministic graph (`npm ci` + `--check` + lint/typecheck/test). Full current doctor in the **scheduled** Expo sync job |
| Expo patch alignment | Manual ticket + `expo install --fix` when doctor goes red | Weekday job: `--check` → `--fix` → doctor → gates → **one** rolling PR |
| Ordinary JS deps | Dependabot groups (testing, dev-tools, tanstack, expo, …) | Keep Dependabot for **non-Expo** packages; stop letting the `expo` group fight the SDK matrix |
| SDK / RN line bump | Human ticket (e.g. [#282](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/282)) | Stay human — never auto-merge |
| Merge contention | `strict: true` on required checks; rebase-whack-a-mole after each Dependabot merge | GitHub Merge Queue **later**, when merge volume justifies it |

This repo is **npm-only**, **Android-only CNG**, Actions already SHA-pinned. Do not introduce pnpm or iOS smoke tests.

## Design (two clocks)

```text
PR CI  = deterministic snapshot of *this commit*
Nightly / weekday dependency CI = allowed to look at the outside world
```

```text
Renovate/Dependabot                  Expo sync job (this ticket)
├─ eslint / prettier / jest          ├─ expo / expo-*
├─ testing libs                       ├─ react-native / react (SDK-pinned)
├─ utilities / boring JS             ├─ Expo-coupled native modules
└─ GitHub Actions (already grouped)  └─ jest-expo / babel-preset-expo
```

**Keep Dependabot** unless we explicitly decide to migrate to Renovate. Grouping already exists. The RN-specific rule is ownership, not “more bots.”

### Risk tiers for auto-merge

| Change | Automation |
| --- | --- |
| Lockfile-only / Expo `--fix` that restores **current SDK 57** expected patches | Auto-merge after CI |
| Dev-dependency patches (eslint, prettier, jest plugins) | Auto-merge after CI |
| Ordinary npm **minor** (non-native) | PR + CI; auto-merge optional |
| RN patch **dictated by current Expo SDK** | Auto-merge only with strong CI |
| Expo **SDK** bump (57 → 58), RN minor/major, config plugin / native ABI | **Human** dedicated ticket |

Critical distinction: *bring SDK 57 deps back to what SDK 57 expects* can be aggressive. *Upgrade the app from SDK 57 to 58* must not merge itself.

### Caveat (do not paper over)

`npx expo install --check` is still an **external** check (Expo’s published compatible versions for this SDK). It can go red overnight even with a frozen lockfile — that is how #314/#343 happened. The weekday `--fix` PR is the mitigation so `main` (and rebased feature PRs) recover in hours, not via drive-by commits on every feature branch. If `--check` remains a required PR check, document that “red without a code change” means “wait for / land the Expo sync PR, then rebase” — not “fix deps on the feature ticket.”

## Scope

Implement in **separate PRs** (one ticket = one PR). At kickoff, split later phases into follow-up issues and keep this issue as the parent / tracker, **or** implement Phase 1 only here and file the rest.

### Phase 1 — Deterministic PR CI (first PR)

- Stop `expo-doctor@latest` in `package.json` `doctor` script and Quality Gates.
- Pin Node in workflows to the engines floor (or `.nvmrc` / `node-version-file`).
- Document: PR CI vs scheduled Expo health.
- Decide whether `expo-doctor` stays **required** on feature PRs or becomes informational (`continue-on-error` / scheduled-only). Default proposal: **keep `expo install --check` required**; move **latest doctor / RN Directory** to the scheduled job.
- Update `docs/ci.md`, `docs/guides/dependabot-process.md`, README doctor notes.

### Phase 2 — Weekday Expo compatibility sync

Scheduled workflow (weekday AM, `workflow_dispatch` too):

```text
npm ci
  → expo install --check
      clean → exit 0
      drift → expo install --fix → expo-doctor → lint/typecheck/test
           → create/update ONE PR: chore(deps): Expo compatibility sync
```

- Bot uses a PAT / `GITHUB_TOKEN` with contents + PR permissions; SHA-pin all actions.
- Never bump Expo SDK major/minor; abort if `expo` major would change.
- Ignore `android/` (gitignored CNG).
- Engineering-only PR (no Needs QA) unless native-linked versions actually change in a way that needs a device smoke — then **Needs QA? Yes** and do **not** auto-merge.

### Phase 3 — Dependabot ownership split + limited auto-merge

- Remove or ignore Expo/RN-coupled packages from Dependabot’s `expo` / `react` / `react-native` groups so they cannot fight `--fix`.
- Enable GitHub auto-merge (squash) for **safe** Dependabot labels only, still one lockfile merge at a time **or** rely on merge queue (Phase 4).
- Keep ignore rules for `react-native >= 0.87`, React minor/major, `op-sqlite` major.

### Phase 4 — Merge queue (optional, maintainer GitHub settings)

Enable merge queue on `main` so approved PRs are tested against the *would-be* main instead of every developer rebasing after each dep merge. Requires required status checks to be real (today only `PR Description` is required in branch protection — see `docs/ci.md`). Do not enable queue until lint/test/typecheck (and the Expo checks we still want) are required, or the queue tests the wrong bar.

## Out of scope

- Expo SDK 58+ upgrade (dedicated ticket when we choose it).
- Switching package managers.
- iOS.
- Replacing Dependabot with Renovate in Phase 1–2 (optional later comparison).
- Auto-merging native/config-plugin/SDK changes.

## Acceptance criteria (parent)

- [ ] Phase 1 merged: no `@latest` doctor on PR CI; Node version pinned; docs updated.
- [ ] Phase 2 merged: weekday (or daily) Expo `--fix` job opens/updates a single compatibility PR; no-op when clean.
- [ ] Phase 3: Dependabot no longer owns Expo/RN-coupled packages; auto-merge policy documented and limited to risk tiers above.
- [ ] SDK / RN line upgrades remain a human ticket with `expo install --fix`, doctor, Android prebuild/smoke — never the weekday bot.
- [ ] Docs: `docs/ci.md`, dependabot process, resolution-log pointer, agent commands (`handle-dependabot`, `dep-bump`) match the two-clock model.
- [ ] Follow-up issues filed for any phase not implemented in the first PR (`Refs` this issue).

## Verification

**Phase 1:** Push a no-op commit twice on different days without rebasing — PR checks should not flip solely because Expo Doctor latest / Node 24.x moved. (`--check` may still flip if Expo published new expected patches; that is Phase 2.)

**Phase 2:** Run `workflow_dispatch` on a branch with known SDK patch drift; confirm one PR; run again with a clean tree — no extra PR / empty commit.

**Phase 3:** Open Dependabot PRs for eslint vs `expo-*`; only the former should appear from Dependabot.

## File pointers

- `.github/workflows/quality-gates.yml` — `expo-doctor`, `expo install --check`
- `package.json` — `"doctor": "npx expo-doctor@latest"`
- `.github/dependabot.yml` — `expo` / `react` / `react-native` groups + ignores
- `docs/ci.md`, `docs/guides/dependabot-process.md`, `.cursor/rules/dependabot-workflow.mdc`
- `.github/workflows/action-pins.yml` — new workflow must SHA-pin `uses:`

## Notes for implementers

- Engineering-only unless Phase 2 actually bumps native modules — then Needs QA, post-merge nightly, do not auto-merge.
- Agents still must not push to `main`; the bot PR is the exception path (bot-authored branch + PR, human or auto-merge per tier).
- Related closed work: #314, #343, #282, #380.
